verdict.rationale: Trello has a documented REST API with key/token and OAuth authorization, configurable scopes, batch, search and webhook endpoints, plus an MCP server for connecting AI tools. That gives substantial programmatic access, but nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the checked paths, so endpoint coverage cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of API/UI parity, a published machine-readable API spec, coverage of UI features such as Inbox, calendar sync and card mirroring via API, and independent hands-on confirmation.
